title: EventBus emit permission denied delivery contract

contract.permission_enforcement: EventBus.emit() requires the events permission for the emitting plugin
contract.delivery_blocked: No registered callbacks receive an event when emit permission is denied
contract.registry_preservation: Permission denial does not modify the listener registry
contract.registry_stability: The listener registry remains intact after a denied emit
contract.failure_isolation: Permission denial occurs before event delivery
contract.no_partial_delivery: No callback receives partial delivery before the permission failure
contract.permission_observation: The denied plugin permission check is recorded before delivery
